scope: Actual research, review, recovery and implementation sessions assigned to this project. Repeated continuations of one session are not new agents.
statusMeaning: Status describes retained deliverable evidence, not a live query of agent execution. Recovery workers inherit only unfinished work.

agents.outcome: Retained 29 original reviewed-file hashes and demonstrated three local checker defects: existing feature-request submission counting, unsupported promotion of unrun follow-ups, and timestamp ordering. Inventoried 16842 snapshot-owned objects and examined 10934 trees. All 262 tracker-path entries were submodule links to the initial commit; four unreferenced blobs matched none of the 29 expected hashes. This is a scoped negative result, not proof of global absence.

limitations: Original research workers reported no child agents. The two later children of the recovery/conversion worker are recorded separately; no unobserved sessions are inferred.
The search service's auxiliary answer engine is not counted as a dispatched subagent.
Raw conversations, private operating notes, environment values and machine-specific process records are excluded.
A saved session ID is provenance, not a promise that the session remains available after a harness restart.
